programmes.d: Detectives chase "Fufu," a villain who stole Escobar's stash from the LAPD. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect a witness.
No matter how hard you try to make it out the streets, something always tries to pull you back in.
Two young men grow up together, graduate college and attempt to start their professional lives. When one takes matters into his own hands, the only family he has winds up with a target on their back.
Blood is not always thicker than water, and not all friends are as loyal as you think. Four different relationships display love, hurt, and betrayal.

Symone, a spirited and vibrant plus-size woman in her 30s, finds herself navigating the unpredictable world of modern dating while grappling with the emotional aftermath of her one-night stand with Andre, her high school sweetheart.
Gotti, a rising kingpin in Dallas , looks to restructure his organization by adding women to his leadership

In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found the one, he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger.

As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Cecelius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam's jealousy spirals into something dangerous.
David and best friend Uriah run a marketing firm together. When he meets Uriah's wife Bathsheba, he begins a dangerous affair that could unravel everything the two friends have built.
When Emily rents a room from a seemingly kind landlord, she discovers his house hides deadly secrets - including past tenants, jealous lovers, and a dark obsession that may cost her life.
A man with bad luck in relationships finally meets Mrs. Right, but she makes a hair-raising decision that challenges him to love her through the thick and thin.

Pastor Gerald's job is on the line if he doesn't increase the attendance of the men in the church. He decides to have a men's retreat, hoping it will fix everything. He realizes God has called upon him to help the men in the church.

The daughter of a prominent Deacon, Tamar is a lesbian and taught that her desires are not that of God. Tamar has suppressed her feelings for 16 years, until she finds herself falling for the only other woman in a ministry class.
